Overview
Your Grain Partner in Agriculture
Landus Cooperative helps connect farmers with the necessary resources to sell grain, anytime and anywhere. From seamless grain transactions and expert advice, to supporting all your transportation and storage needs, and so much more. Landus Cooperative is committed to serving as your partner in agriculture.
Your One Stop
Grain Bids, Sell Grain, & Expert Advice
We understand the importance of seamless grain selling and access to expert advice. With our user-friendly portal and app, you can sell your grain anytime, anywhere, directly from your computer or phone, 24/7. Streamline your grain selling process and conduct business with ease.
Live Futures and grain bids
Expert advice on the markets of the day
Create contracts
Set up ACH
Sign contracts
SELL GRAIN NOW VIEW GRAIN BIDS
Locations
For farmers seeking convenience and reliability in their grain transactions, Landus Cooperative is proud to offer 50 locations throughout the state of Iowa. Our extensive network of facilities offers full-service capabilities to buy, process, and ship your grain efficiently and effectively.
Additionally, many of our locations offer a comprehensive range of agronomy products and services, ensuring that your farming needs are fully met under one roof.
VIEW OUR LOCATIONS
Grain Marketing
We leverage advanced data analytics to integrate grain marketing, agronomy purchasing, logistics, and operations seamlessly. By harnessing the power of data-driven insights, we optimize transportation routes, streamline operations, and maximize efficiency, providing our members and farmers with the best possible solutions.
MARKET YOUR GRAIN
Download our Grain Policy for more information
Download 2026-2027 Grain Policy
Supply Chain Solutions
We deliver innovative supply chain solutions in food and feed that will help you meet your goals.
WHO WE SERVE →
Farmers
We provide grain marketing services, transportation, and storage options.
Grain Processors
We ensure a steady and reliable supply of grain to processors.
Pet food Manufacturers
We supply pet food manufacturers with grains and specialty ingredients.
Animal Feed Manufacturers
We supply pet food manufacturers with grains and specialty ingredients.
Food & Beverage Manufacturers
We enable manufacturers to produce high-quality products for consumers.
Your Landus Cooperative Grain Team
The Landus Cooperative Grain Team has a collective 140 years of experience to serve you. We work with you to understand your goals and preferences. Your team takes the noise out of the marketplace to help you make decisions, and we take the hassle out of trading to help you enjoy a positive experience.
Contact the Team
FARM SERVICES
Your Partner in Agriculture
Storage Capacity - With our expertise in marketing and logistics, we effectively manage storage capacity across all our growing regions. Explore our regional facility websites to discover how we optimize storage solutions to meet your needs.
Transportation - From providing extra trucks during harvest to offering on-farm pickup services, we're dedicated to ensuring your operation runs smoothly. Count on us as your reliable transportation partner.
Marketing Alternatives - In today's dynamic market, you need adaptive, comprehensive, and transparent tools and risk management solutions. At Landus Cooperative, we're committed to innovation and flexibility, constantly exploring new ways to support you in achieving your goals.
Discover how Landus Cooperative can empower your farming operation. Contact us today to learn more about our services and how we can help you succeed.
Contact Us
Customized Transportation   Solutions for Your Success
Landus Cooperative offers a comprehensive range of transportation solutions tailored to the needs of our customers. We're committed to delivering value-added transportation solutions that help our customers succeed.  
Contact us to learn more about how we can support your transportation needs and enhance your supply chain efficiency.
CONTACT US →
Rail Access
Landus Cooperative is the only agricultural retailer in the state of Iowa with access to all Iowa railroads which includes five Class I railroads. We provide access to efficient and cost-effective transportation options.
Cross Country Hauling
We offer cross-country hauling services to meet your long-distance transportation needs. Our dedicated fleet and network of carriers ensure reliable and efficient delivery.
On-Farm Pickup
For added convenience, we offer on-farm pickup services, allowing farmers to sell their grain directly from their fields. Our experienced logistics team coordinates pick up schedules and ensures timely collection, so you can focus on your farm operations.
